=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:22135-22139 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The new `escalate_human` keep-rule in invoke_stall_judge decides that `attempt_merge` cannot act by reading the state of the last cross-referenced PR (`_issue_cross_ref_pr_number_last`, line 21753 / `_fetch_pr_json`, line 21767), and never checks that this PR is the issue's implementation PR.
  WHY: If an unrelated or superseded PR is the last cross-reference and is closed or merged, the rule keeps `escalate_human` and adds `ai:needs-human`, even when the real implementation PR is open and mergeable; this pauses recovery and bypasses `ENABLE_STALL_HUMAN_TERMINALIZATION=false` normalisation. All three reviewers rated it MAJOR. Suggested fix: add `&& _pr_json_is_issue_implementation_pr "${issue_num}" "${linked_pr_json}"` to the condition at line 22136, with no new API call.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:25314 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: run_standalone_stall_recovery prints `STALL_SKIP issue=${issue_num} reason=linked_pr_merged ...` at line 25314, then `_reconcile_standalone_merged_pr_issue` prints its own `STALL_SKIP ... reason=merged_non_target_base ...` at line 23625, so the same skip is logged twice on every tick.
  WHY: `STALL_SKIP` is a stable log prefix (README.md line 3898) that log analysis and dashboards count, so affected issues are double-counted on every poll. Only observability is affected. Both reviewers rated it NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:invoke_stall_judge, lines 22135-22139 (the new `escalate_human` keep-rule). It reads `target_pr` and `pr_state`, which come from `linked_pr="$(_issue_cross_ref_pr_number_last "${issue_num}" ...)"` at line 21753 and `_fetch_pr_json` at line 21767. | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The keep-rule decides from the last cross-referencing PR of any kind (`_issue_cross_ref_pr_number_last`, lines 4889-4904). The `attempt_merge` arms instead resolve their target through `_resolve_issue_implementation_pr` (line 23179), which is gated by `_pr_json_is_issue_implementation_pr` (line 22929). This repeats the #3816 / #3828 mis-target warned about at lines 25956-25959.
  WHY: An open, mergeable `ai/issue-N` PR plus a later closed or merged "Refs #N" PR means `escalate_human` overrides the normalisation to `attempt_merge` and adds `ai:needs-human`, ignoring `ENABLE_STALL_HUMAN_TERMINALIZATION=false` (normalize_stall_recovery_action, line 18758). Fix: add `&& _pr_json_is_issue_implementation_pr "${issue_num}" "${linked_pr_json}"` at line 22136. The #9482 shape still passes, because PR #825 has head ref `ai/issue-823`.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:run_standalone_stall_recovery, line 25314 (new `echo "STALL_SKIP issue=${issue_num} reason=linked_pr_merged ..."`), followed by `_reconcile_standalone_merged_pr_issue` at line 25315, which prints `STALL_SKIP issue=... reason=merged_non_target_base ...` at line 23625. | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When a standalone PR merges into `orchestrator/project-*` (a non-target base per `_pr_json_base_is_target_merge`), two `STALL_SKIP` lines are printed for one skip on every tick.
  WHY: README.md line 3898 lists `STALL_SKIP` as a stable log prefix, so these skips are double-counted. Control flow is correct. Fix: print the new line only when the reconcile does not print its own, or use a different prefix.
- TASK COMPLETENESS / INTENT GAPS: NONE. All #9482 deliverables are present: `merged`/`merged_at` diagnostics (lines 21772-21776), the ready-to-merge resolver fallback and merged guard (lines 25272-25297, 25312-25319), the `STALL_SKIP ... reason=linked_pr_merged` line, the escalate_human keep-rule (lines 22135-22139), and tests (tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py, lines 15311-15436). Verification note (stated as not a gap): the pre-push gate reports "Status: fail" with 3 failures (`tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py`, `tests/test_orchestrate_lib.py`, `shellcheck`), tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py is unverified (timeout), acceptance tests are "not run", and check-run collection hit `status=timeout`. The reviewer could not tie these failures to any changed hunk.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: line 22136 implementation-PR check (1 line); line 25314 deduplicate the `STALL_SKIP` line (3 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2 (2 related items)
